en: Figure 1: SkillGen overview. Our multi-agent framework synthesizes a single auditable skill from baseline trajectories. 1 It first elicits successful and failed rollouts as input. 2 It extracts reusable patterns of successful and failure modes. 3 It follows an iterative generation-verification-refinement loop to generate and refine new candidate skills.
zh: 图 1：SkillGen 概览。多智能体框架从基线轨迹合成单个可审计技能。① 首先采集成功与失败执行作为输入。② 提取成功模式与失败模式中的可复用规律。③ 通过迭代的生成—验证—改进循环生成并改进新的候选技能。

en: Figure 2: Comparison with skill-generation baselines. Accuracy improvement (\Delta) from adding a generated skill across representative benchmark–model entries. Mini, Grok, and Gemma denote GPT-5.4-Mini, Grok-4-Fast, and Gemma-4-26B, respectively. All methods use the same evaluation harness.
zh: 图 2：与技能生成基线的比较。在代表性基准—模型条目上，加入生成技能带来的准确率提升（\Delta）。Mini、Grok 和 Gemma 分别表示 GPT-5.4-Mini、Grok-4-Fast 和 Gemma-4-26B。所有方法使用相同的评估框架。

en: Figure 3: SkillGen ablations. \Delta accuracy over a shared no-skill baseline on ALFWorld (OOD) and ChemLLMBench yield prediction. A1: ICL (k=3) instead of the induced skill; A2: no refinement; A3: no verification gate; A4: no Failure Lessons; A5: plain-text skill (no script+reference bundle); Full: complete SkillGen. Full wins on every dataset–model pair, showing that each component contributes.
zh: 图 3：SkillGen 消融。在 ALFWorld（OOD）和 ChemLLMBench 产率预测上，相对共同无技能基线的准确率变化 \Delta。A1：以 ICL（k=3）替代归纳技能；A2：无改进；A3：无验证门控；A4：无失败教训；A5：纯文本技能（无脚本与参考资料包）；Full：完整 SkillGen。Full 在每个数据集—模型对上均胜出，表明每个组成部分都有贡献。

en: Figure 4: Cross-model skill transferability. Each heatmap reports \Delta accuracy when a skill generated by a source model (row) is executed by an evaluator model (column). Diagonal cells are self-transfer, while off-diagonal cells are cross-model transfer. Right and bottom margins show transfer-out and transfer-in means, respectively; color saturates at \pm 30 pp. The transfer matrix is evaluated on a shared pool of 100 held-out instances per benchmark, distinct from the main evaluation split, to ensure that baseline trajectories are consistent across all 36 (source, evaluator) pairs.
zh: 图 4：跨模型技能可迁移性。每张热图报告由源模型（行）生成、由评估模型（列）执行技能时的准确率变化 \Delta。对角单元是自迁移，非对角单元是跨模型迁移。右侧和底部边缘分别展示迁出与迁入均值；颜色在 ±30 个百分点处饱和。为确保全部 36 个（源模型，评估模型）配对的基线轨迹一致，迁移矩阵使用每个基准共享的 100 个留出实例池进行评估，且与主评估划分不同。

en: Figure 5: Insights for \tau-Bench. Held-out accuracy on \tau-Bench retail for the five models where the SkillGen verification gate activated. Gray bars are no-skill baselines and teal bars apply the induced skill; deltas are absolute percentage-point changes.
zh: 图 5：τ-Bench 分析。在 SkillGen 验证门控启用的五个模型上，τ-Bench 零售任务的留出准确率。灰柱为无技能基线，青绿色柱为使用归纳技能的结果；差值为绝对百分点变化。

en: Figure 6: Insights for ChemLLMBench. Held-out accuracy on ChemLLMBench property prediction (left) and yield prediction (right). Gray bars are no-skill baselines and teal bars apply the SkillGen skill; bars labeled “\pm 0.0” or “gate off” indicate no measurable change or rejection by the verification gate.
zh: 图 6：ChemLLMBench 分析。ChemLLMBench 性质预测（左）与产率预测（右）的留出准确率。灰柱为无技能基线，青绿色柱为使用 SkillGen 技能；标记“±0.0”或“gate off”的柱表示无可测变化或被验证门控拒绝。

en: Figure 7: Refinement rounds vs. skill accuracy. Each refinement round produces one candidate skill evaluated on the construction-time verification subset. (a) Per-round candidate accuracy for representative runs, with dashed no-skill baselines. (b) Best-so-far accuracy under a budget of K rounds. (c) Aggregate mean \Delta accuracy over all runs with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals.
zh: 图 7：改进轮数与技能准确率。每轮改进产生一个在构建期验证子集上评估的候选技能。（a）代表性运行中每轮候选技能的准确率，虚线为无技能基线。（b）K 轮预算下截至当前的最佳准确率。（c）所有运行的平均准确率变化 \Delta，以及 95% bootstrap 置信区间。

en: Figure 8: t-SNE visualization of SkillGen’s induction on ALFWorld (gpt-5.4-nano). Red triangles (F1–F7) are failure trajectories; green circles (S1–S8) are successes. Gray arrows link each failure to its nearest same-type success (20 contrastive pairs). The yellow band marks the decision boundary between the two populations. Failures cluster compactly in the upper region (recurring planning errors), while successes spread broadly (diverse solving strategies), motivating the contrastive analysis that drives skill generation.
zh: 图 8：SkillGen 在 ALFWorld（gpt-5.4-nano）上的归纳 t-SNE 可视化。红色三角形（F1–F7）为失败轨迹；绿色圆形（S1–S8）为成功轨迹。灰箭头将每个失败连接到最近的同类型成功案例（20 个对比配对）。黄色带标示两类群体间的决策边界。失败在上部区域紧密聚集（反复出现的规划错误），而成功分布较广（多样的求解策略），这为驱动技能生成的对比分析提供了动机。
